title: NewGen Increases K25.ai Ownership to 10% in Closed Pre-A Round at US$100 Million Valuation with Total US$10 Million Invested
summary: K25.ai completed its US$10M Pre-A round and began Series A fundraising for product launch, licensing and expansion across selected Asian markets.
body_markdown:
On the day this news was published, **NIVF** declined **5.38%** , reflecting a notable negative market reaction. Argus tracked a peak move of **+24.3%** during that session. Argus tracked a trough of **-20.2%** from its starting point during tracking. Our momentum scanner triggered **38 alerts** that day, indicating elevated trading interest and price volatility. This price movement removed approximately **$183K** from the company's valuation, bringing the market cap to **$3.22M** at that time.


Data tracked by[StockTitan Argus](https://www.stocktitan.net/scanner/momentum) on the day of publication.
